To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) buyback contract can coordinate the manufacturer led supply chain, (ii) option contract can coordinate the retailer led supply chain, and (iii) risk sharing mechanism can improve the cotton firm's profitability.

(1) the buyback contract can coordinate the supply chain under manufacturer lead and the retailer can lead the supply chain using the option contract, (2) the risk sharing mechanism between fiber and cotton firms can improve the cotton firm's profitability, and (3) the risk averse behavior of the cotton firms leads to the unsold inventory problem.

(a) the buyback contract coordinates the supply chain for manufacturer led scenario; (b) the option contract coordinates the supply channel for retailer led scenario; (c) the risk sharing mechanism can improve the profitability of cotton firm for manufacturer led scenario and the risk averse behavior of cotton firm can lead to the cotton inventory problem; and (d) the buyback bidirectional penalty contract can coordinate the supply chain under production uncertainty.
